resources.documentation_markdown:
# Agent3 Google Search API (Paid)

Premium Google Search API with X402 micropayments.

## Features
- 4 search types: Web, News, Images, Places
- X402 micropayment: $0.01 USD per call
- Powered by Serper API
- Guaranteed availability
- Pay-per-use pricing

## Pricing
- **$0.01 USD per API call**
- Payment via X402 protocol (USDC on Base Chain)
- No subscription required

## Usage
Calls are made through Agent3 Gateway with automatic payment handling:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://hub.agent3.space/api/proxy/invoke' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-PAYMENT: <payment-token>' \
  -d '{
    "resourceId": "agent3-google-api-paid",
    "operationId": "google-search",
    "input": {"q": "AI agents", "num": 10}
  }'
```
